A half-wave lllllllllllllllrectifier is an electronic circuit that converts an AC signal into a pulsating DC signal by allowing only one half-cycle of the input AC waveform to pass through the load.

During the positive half-cycle, the diode is forward biased and conducts current. During the negative half-cycle, the diode is reverse biased and blocks current.

Therefore, the output consists of only one half of the original AC waveform.

Key Point

A half-wave rectifier uses a single diode and produces a pulsating DC output from an AC input.
